comments: Input facts: ego is the car responder; agent1 is the pedestrian initiator; one actor travels along the trafficway and the other crosses it without traveling along or onto another trafficway. Chosen assumptions: agent1 initiates an immediate perpendicular crossing from the left toward the right. Ego is the exposed responder and continues with its ordinary lane-following controller, with no additional explicit evasive maneuver. Initial longitudinal separation is 18–24 m; left lateral offset is 4–5 m; pedestrian speed is 1.3–1.7 m/s; ego target speed is 7–9 m/s. The target lies 4–5 m right of the lane center. No collision outcome is required. Adjacent lanes are not needed; the road fields do not forbid them.
